newsitem.title: USA: SpectRx Inc sells 160,000 shrs at $7/shr.
newsitem.headline: SpectRx Inc sells 160,000 shrs at $7/shr.

text.p: SpectRx Inc said Wednesday it sold 160,000 shares of common stock at $7.00 per share, in a partial exercise of its underwriters' over-allotment option.
The company said it had granted its underwriters an option to buy up to 330,255 more shares, in connection with its July 1 public offering of 2,201,699 shares.
The total proceeds to the company before commissions and expenses is $15,120,000, said SpectRx, which now has about 7.7 million shares outstanding.
SpectRx specializes in minimally and non-invasive diagnostic and monitoring systems which are designed to reduce or eliminate pain, require no blood and provide rapid results.
